Rules.ModSwitch.Tip: On: the mod runs on export and Preview, after the mods above it. Off: it does not run.
Rules.ModConflicts.Tip: {count} value another mod that is on also changes (the lower mod wins):|{count} values another mod that is on also changes (the lower mod wins):
Rules.ModLetter.Has.Tip: {part}: {count} rule from the Armory in this mod. Click to see it.|{part}: {count} rules from the Armory in this mod. Click to see them.
Rules.ModLetter.None.Tip: {part}: no changes from the Armory in this mod. Click to open {part}.
Rules.NoPresetsInThis: No rule sets in this mod.
Rules.DoubleClickARule: Double-click a rule to open it. Rules run top to bottom. Ctrl-click or Shift-click selects several, in the rule set list too. Ctrl+X, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, Ctrl+A and Delete act on the selection; Ctrl+Up and Ctrl+Down move rules.
Rules.NewRule.Tip: Add a rule below the selected one. Ctrl+N adds an Edit rule
Rules.Fold.Tip: Hide the rules in this group
Rules.Editor.Name: Name
Rules.Editor.Choice.End.AtTheEnd: At the end of the file
Rules.Editor.NewIds: Give the copy its own GUIDs
Rules.Editor.CollectHint.DescriptorTitle: Descriptor Title, or a property name
Rules.Editor.WhereThisMatchesA: Where this matches a collected value
Rules.Editor.Group.Note: Holds the rules below it, up to the next group. They only touch descriptors that also meet these conditions, and disabling the group disables them. With no conditions it is just a heading.
Rules.Editor.Add.Note: Runs once per file. Skipped if the name is already in the file or the text is not valid NDF. Written as typed; later rules do not edit it.
Rules.Editor.Clone.Note: Copies the descriptor as it is when this rule runs and places the copy after it. Later rules can edit the copy. Skipped if the new name exists. New GUIDs come from the new name, so they are the same on every export.
Rules.Editor.Remove.Note: **Deletes every descriptor that meets the conditions.** Needs at least one condition.
Rules.Editor.Replace.Note: Checks every value in the descriptor. Property names and the descriptor's name are not changed.
Rules.Editor.Formula.Note: Takes property names from the same descriptor, numbers, + - * / and brackets. `value` is the target's current value. A name with a slash goes in square brackets: `[EVisionRange/Standard]`. Functions: min, max, abs, floor, ceil, round(x), round(x, step). A descriptor is skipped if a property is missing or not a number.
Rules.Editor.Table.Note: Paste from a spreadsheet, or type text separated by commas, semicolons or tabs. First row: property names. First column: descriptor names. Empty cells are skipped. Rows for descriptors not in the file are listed under Skipped.
Rules.Editor.Lookup.Note: Edits descriptors in this file from a list read in another file. The other file must be on the Files tab; it is read as loaded, before its own rules.
Rules.Editor.Lookup.ReferenceNote: A reference matches by its last part: `$/GFX/Weapon/WeaponDescriptor_X` matches `WeaponDescriptor_X`.
Rules.Editor.Check.Note: Changes nothing. Counts the descriptors that meet the conditions and warns on the Files tab when the count is not as expected, such as after a game update renamed something.
Rules.Editor.Scope.RemoveTypeNote: Takes every object of this type that passes the conditions out of the list it is in. Objects not in a list are left alone.
Rules.Editor.Scope.TypeNote: Runs on every object of this type, at any depth. Conditions and targets see only that object. Descriptor Title is the title of its descriptor; Descriptor Type is its own type.
Rules.Editor.Scope.ConstantsNote: Runs on top-level values written as `Name is 5`. Together they act as one descriptor: use a constant's name as a target or in a condition.
Rules.Editor.Variable.Note: Write `{variable}` in any value, condition, table cell or formula. Formulas also take the bare name. Applies to the whole rule set, wherever it sits, unless its group is switched off.
Rules.Editor.Title: Rule
Rules.Editor.Add.Text.Tip: Paste the whole descriptor, from its comment or export line. Ctrl+scroll changes the text size.
Rules.Editor.Lookup.SourceConditions: Descriptors to read in the other file
Rules.Editor.Lookup.ToEdit: Descriptors to edit in this file
Rules.Editor.Enabled.Tip: Off: the rule stays in the list and does not run
Rules.Editor.Gate.Tip: Any: one condition is enough. All: every condition must match.
Rules.Mod.Exists: A mod with that name already exists.
Rules.Mod.DeleteAskWithPresets: Delete the mod "{mod}" and its {presets}? Export it first if you want to keep a copy.
Rules.Mod.ImportExists: A mod named "{mod}" already exists, with {existing}. The file holds {count}. Replace it, keep both, or skip?
Rules.Mod.NotSaved: The mod could not be saved. {reason}
Rules.ClipboardBusy: The clipboard is in use by another program. Try again.
Rules.Preset.NewName: Name for the new rule set:
Rules.Preset.SelectToCopy: Select a rule set to copy.
Rules.Preset.Exists: This mod already has a rule set with that name.
Rules.Preset.FilesUseIt: It applies to {count} file on the Files tab.|They apply to {count} files on the Files tab.
Rules.NoRules: No rules yet. Click "New rule" to add one, or paste rules with Ctrl+V.
Rules.NoRulesNoPreset: No rules yet. Click "New rule" to add one; it also creates a rule set to hold it.
Rules.Paste.Nothing: The clipboard holds no EasyNDF rule set, rule, condition or action.
Rules.Paste.SelectRule: Select a rule before pasting conditions or actions.
Rules.Paste.MadePreset: Created the rule set "{preset}" for it. Rename it after its file, such as "My mod (Ammunition.ndf)", or set its Applies To, and it runs on that file.
Rules.Rows.SelectFirst: Select one or more rows first.
Rules.Paste.NoConditionsHere: The selected rule is a type that does not take conditions.
Rules.Paste.NoActionsHere: The selected rule is a type that does not take actions.
Rules.KindSummary.Edit: Changes values in every descriptor that matches. The one you'll use most.
Rules.KindSummary.Add: Adds a new descriptor, written exactly as you type it.
Rules.KindSummary.Clone: Copies a descriptor under a new name, then changes the copy.
Rules.KindSummary.Remove: Deletes every descriptor that matches. Needs at least one condition.
Rules.KindSummary.Replace: Replaces a value wherever it appears.
Rules.KindSummary.Scale: Changes a number, then rounds it and keeps it within limits you set.
Rules.KindSummary.Formula: Works out a value from other values, like `round(0.8 * MaximumRangeGRU, 25)`.
Rules.KindSummary.Table: Applies values pasted from a spreadsheet: one row per descriptor.
Rules.KindSummary.Lookup: Changes descriptors based on a list in another file.
Rules.KindSummary.Check: Changes nothing. Warns you when the number of matches isn't what you expect.
Rules.KindSummary.Group: A heading with one on/off switch for the rules under it.
Rules.KindSummary.Variable: A named value you can use in other rules as `{Name}`. Change it once to change many rules.
Rules.Group.DeleteAsk: Deleting a group heading leaves its rules in the group above, or in none. Delete it?
Rules.Group.DoNotAskAgain: Do not ask again until the app is closed
Rules.Scan.Hint: Scan a file to fill the dropdowns. Files on the Files tab are scanned automatically.
Rules.Scan.Title: Scan file
Rules.Watermark.Title: Watermark: {mod}
Rules.Watermark.Lead: Exporting with the watermark of {mod}. Change anything that is out of date:
Rules.Row.Name: Name
Rules.Row.Custom.Tip: Type a name instead of choosing one
Rules.Row.Value.Tip: Enter closes this window. Shift+Enter adds a line break.
Rules.Row.ActionNote: A target is a property name at any depth, or a pair key such as a MAP entry. Insert and Replace take `index:value`; index is a number, FirstIndex, LastIndex, or an offset like LastIndex-1. \n is a line break. {Name} inserts a variable.
Rules.Row.Comment.Tip: Add a comment after each edited value
Rules.Row.OriginalValue.Tip: Add the value before the edit
Rules.Suggest.Round.Tip: round(x): Round to the nearest whole number.\nround(x, step): Round to the nearest step, like 25.
Rules.Suggest.Value.Tip: The current value of the property being changed.
Rules.Suggest.Abs.Tip: The value without its minus sign.
Rules.Suggest.Floor.Tip: Round down to a whole number.
Rules.Suggest.Ceil.Tip: Round up to a whole number.
Rules.Suggest.FirstIndex.Tip: The list's first item, the same as 0.
Rules.Suggest.LastIndex.Tip: The list's last item. LastIndex-1 is the one before it.
Rules.Suggest.Variable.Tip: A variable of this rule set, set by its Variable rule.
Rules.Suggest.Descriptor.Tip: A descriptor in the scanned file.
Rules.Suggest.Type.Tip: A descriptor type in the scanned file.
Rules.Suggest.Property.Tip: A property in the scanned file.
Rules.Locked.Tip: Made from the Armory: change it there, or open it and choose Make Editable.
Rules.Locked.Refused: Rules made from the Armory are changed there. To change one here, open it and choose Make Editable.
Rules.Locked.DeleteAsk: These rules are changes made in the Armory. Deleting them takes the changes back there: a game division gets those values back as the game has them, and a division or unit the mod makes is deleted whole (a unit is taken out of the mod's divisions too); a battlegroup's rules empty only its battlegroup. Delete them?
Rules.Locked.PresetDeleteAsk: It holds changes made in the Armory: they are all taken back, and the mod's own divisions and units are deleted.
Rules.Locked.BattlegroupsDeleteAsk: It holds the battlegroups changed in the Armory: they are all taken back, and the mod's own divisions get empty battlegroups again.
Rules.Locked.PresetRefused: An Armory rule set holds changes made in the Armory. Undo them in the Armory to remove it.
Rules.Locked.Title: Made from the Armory.
Rules.Locked.Text: It follows what you change there, so it is read-only here.
Rules.Locked.ShowInArmory.Tip: Show this rule's division or unit in the Armory.
Rules.Locked.MakeEditable.Tip: Keep this rule by hand from now on. The Armory stops showing the change.
Rules.Locked.MakeEditable.Ask: Keep this change as a rule you edit by hand? The Armory lets go of it: it no longer shows or changes it. For a new division or unit, all of its rules are kept by hand; for a new division's battlegroup, only its battlegroup's rules.
Rules.Locked.ArmoryNotRead: Open the Armory first, so its divisions and units are read.
Rules.Armory.OwnRulesElsewhere: Armory rule sets only hold changes made in the Armory.
Rules.Armory.NoChanges: No changes yet. Changes made in the Armory's {part} sub-tab show here as rules.
Rules.Armory.Divisions.Tip: The changes made to divisions in the Armory, as rules. They run on the division files on the Files tab when you export.
Rules.Armory.Battlegroups.Tip: The changes made to Official Battlegroups in the Armory, as rules. They run on Decks.ndf and DeckPacks.ndf on the Files tab when you export.
Rules.Armory.Units.Tip: The units made in the Armory, as rules. They run on UniteDescriptor.ndf, DeckSerializer.ndf and, for a card picture of your own, ButtonTexturesUnites.ndf on the Files tab when you export.
Rules.AppliesTo.None.Tip: This rule set runs on no file: its name holds no file name, and it lists none. Click Change... to choose its files.
Rules.AppliesTo.Change.Tip: Choose the files this rule set applies to
Rules.AppliesTo.Title: Applies To: {ruleSet}
Rules.AppliesTo.ByName.Tip: On: the rule set applies to the files its name holds. Off: to the files ticked below.
Rules.AppliesTo.NameHolds: Its name holds {files}, so it applies to the files of that name. Renaming the rule set changes them.
Rules.AppliesTo.NameHoldsNone: Its name holds no file name, so by its name it applies to no file.
Rules.AppliesTo.Add.Tip: Add the file typed in, ticked
Rules.AppliesTo.TypedFile.Hint: A file not on the Files tab, such as Strategic/GDConstants.ndf
Rules.AppliesTo.TypedFile.Tip: A file name, with the folders it sits in before it to pick one of two files of the same name
Rules.AppliesTo.Note: A folder before the name, as in Strategic/GDConstants.ndf, picks one of two files of the same name. Kept in the mod, so it goes with the mod when it is shared.
Rules.AppliesTo.Done.Tip: Keep this choice in the mod
Rules.KindSummary.Text: Adds texts to a dictionary file such as UNITS.csv: one line per token.
Rules.KindSummary.File: Puts a file of your own into the mod on export: a picture, a video, a new NDF file.
Rules.Editor.Text.Note: One text per line: `TOKEN;Text`. The rule set must apply to a dictionary file on the Files tab, such as `UNITS.csv` or `INTERFACE_OUTGAME.csv`; the export writes it with these lines added, in place of lines with the same token.
Rules.Editor.File.Note: The file is written into the mod's folder on export: the folder that holds the GameData (or CommonData) folder of a file this rule set applies to. EasyNDF keeps its own copy, so the mod still has the file if the chosen one is moved or changed. Export mod carries the file with the mod.
Rules.Editor.File.Choose.Tip: Choose the file to put into the mod
Rules.Editor.File.Choose.Title: Choose the File to Put Into the Mod
Rules.Editor.File.Missing: {file}: EasyNDF no longer has this file. Choose it again.
Rules.Editor.File.DestinationHint: Where in the mod, such as GameData/Assets/2D/Interface/Logo.png
